section: Lettering: the hero, a line over the scene, the first spread

options.name: Now
options.line: Instrument Serif for the lines, Inter for the small type. Editorial, like a magazine.

options.name: Water Brush
options.line: A loaded brush with a big swash on the capital, and Courier Prime as the typewriter. The nearest to your mock-ups.

options.name: Caramel
options.line: A smoother brush script that stays easy to read at any size, with the same Courier Prime.

options.name: Comforter
options.line: An upright, rougher hand, as if written quickly with a marker, and Special Elite, a worn typewriter.
